verdict.rationale: Deel's first-party pages say it pays every worker type, including contractors, in 150+ countries with automated compliance. Its API documents a contractor-contract creation endpoint, which covers compliant contracts for international contractors. One community report says Deel pushed contractors toward its Deel Wallet payout card. That concerns how payouts are received, not whether local-currency payment works, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of payout in contractors' local currencies, detail on how contracts are made compliant per country (e.g., misclassification safeguards), and independent hands-on corroboration of international contractor payments.
